title: PowerScale - Quota Detail
description: Historical usage and thresholds for a selected quota path.

list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "quota" WITH KEY = "cluster"
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "quota" WITH KEY = "cluster"

list.name: path
list.label: Quota Path
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "quota" WITH KEY = "path" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "quota" WITH KEY = "path" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/

list.name: quota_type
list.label: Quota Type
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "quota" WITH KEY = "quota_type" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "path" = ${path:singlequote}
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "quota" WITH KEY = "quota_type" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "path" = ${path:singlequote}

list.name: include_snapshots
list.label: Includes Snapshots
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "quota" WITH KEY = "include_snapshots" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "path" = ${path:singlequote} AND "quota_type" = ${quota_type:singlequote}
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "quota" WITH KEY = "include_snapshots" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "path" = ${path:singlequote} AND "quota_type" = ${quota_type:singlequote}

options.content:
## PowerScale - Quota Detail

Usage, limits, and inode history for the selected quota path. If several quota
domains share a path, use quota type and snapshot inclusion to disambiguate
them. Missing lines indicate an unset threshold or a value that OneFS reports
as not ready; they are never converted to zero.

targets.query: SELECT mean("usage_bytes") FROM "quota" WHERE "cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "path" = ${path:singlequote} AND "quota_type" = ${quota_type:singlequote} AND "include_snapshots" = ${include_snapshots:singlequote} AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "quota_id" fill(null)
